claim_scope: A production-candidate model-and-harness configuration, not a model-held-constant harness ablation. Sol judge labels are provisional and derivative, not human gold.

landed_basis.same_arm_variance: Two byte-identical Luna/high Mike runs scored 163/225 and 172/225 and flipped 31 criterion verdicts.
landed_basis.best_luna_harnesses: Native one-shot scored 177/225 and conflict-first 178/225, margins too small to separate from observed volatility.
landed_basis.failed_determinism: The host-selected fact index scored 165/225; model-selected private quote-first grounding scored 162/225. Both spent attention while rotating or increasing omissions.
landed_basis.diagnosis: All relevant cells had complete evidence coverage and schema-correct tools. The remaining bottleneck is Luna's long-context salience and synthesis, not retrieval availability.

hypothesis: Stop adding context machinery. Apply the strongest available reasoning model to the smallest measured architecture: one exact whole-source fetch, exact-request recency, one evidence-to-all-deliverables inference, native professional grounding, compact Markdown authoring, and terminal success.
trace_gate: Require every exact source read once before drafting, two provider turns, all deliverables in the terminal second response, valid DOCX files, default reported tier, matching fingerprints, and zero tool/schema/path errors. Inspect cache, retries, tokens, reasoning, output size, and latency before judging.
decision_rule: Advance as a production candidate only at 184/225 or better, with no task scoring below fresh Luna/high Mike, and no more than 2.0x fresh-Mike logical tokens. Report the model change separately from the harness delta and flag same-model performer/judge preference as uncertainty.
